summary: Cherskiy Airport (CYX/UESS) is a medium-sized regional airport serving the remote settlement of Cherskiy in the Sakha Republic (Yakutia) in far northeastern Russia. Situated near the mouth of the Kolyma River along the East Siberian Sea, it functions as a critical lifeline for this isolated Arctic community where road and rail connections are virtually nonexistent. The airport supports year-round operations despite harsh subarctic weather conditions with extreme winter temperatures.
faqs:
Q: What is the best way to reach Cherskiy Airport?
A: Most travelers arrive by regional flights from Yakutsk, as the settlement has no road or rail links to the outside world. Air travel is essentially the only practical way to access Cherskiy.

Q: When is the airport operational?
A: The airport operates year-round, though winter flights can be affected by extreme cold temperatures and reduced visibility. Summer months offer the most reliable weather conditions.

Q: What facilities are available at the airport?
A: As a medium-sized regional airport, Cherskiy offers basic terminal facilities including a small waiting area. Travelers should bring their own food and entertainment as amenities are limited.

Q: Why is Cherskiy Airport strategically important?
A: It serves the only significant settlement in the lower Kolyma region and supports nearby mining operations, scientific research stations, and indigenous communities in this remote Arctic territory.
transport_tips: Taxis and local vehicles are the only options for the short transfer between the airport and Cherskiy town center, typically taking under 15 minutes. Pre-arranging ground transport is recommended, as rental car services are not available and the local transport network is informal. Visitors should confirm return flight schedules well in advance, as flights are infrequent and weather-related cancellations are common.
local_tip: Pack extra warm clothing in your carry-on during winter months (November through April), as temperatures can plunge below minus 40°C and you may need to wait outdoors for ground transport upon arrival.
